title: A key-encryption key (master-v<N>.key)
caption: ADR-0010 rotation; runbook docs/mvp/runbooks/master-key-rotation.md. Key ids are `local:v<N>`; files are identical copies in /etc/velexis/keys/platform/ and /etc/velexis/keys/ota/.

states.label: Generated (32 random bytes, base64, mode 0400)
states.detail: `provision-vm.sh --steps keys` on the VM; `pnpm dev:keys` locally (mode 0600).

states.label: Old: decrypt only
states.detail: Still loaded by `fromDir`; envelopes naming it still decrypt.

states.label: Removed from both folders
states.detail: Only when both commands report zero rows under it; back up /etc/velexis afterwards.

states.label: Refused at start (KeyProviderError)
states.detail: Group/other mode bits, not 32 bytes, `master-v01.key`, or no file for MASTER_KEY_CURRENT.
